write.vi: Hai đến ba mắt xích, mỗi mắt xích có giải thích. Dùng hai nhóm cấu trúc nhân quả khác nhau (lead to… và because of…). Dùng can / may / be likely to, tránh khẳng định tuyệt đối.
write.exampleEn: Using a phone in bed may lead to shorter sleep, which in turn makes it harder to concentrate the next day.

recall.vi: If + hiện tại đơn, will + V. If + quá khứ đơn, would + V. unless = if not. provided that + hiện tại đơn.
recall.exampleEn: Unless students go to bed earlier, they will find mornings difficult.

write.prompt: Many teenagers keep their phones in their bedroom at night. Explain ONE effect this habit may have on their well-being. Write a paragraph.
write.taskVi: đoạn 120–140 từ (mở rộng: 150–170 từ, không khung): câu chủ đề, chuỗi hai–ba mắt xích, ví dụ, câu kết.
mustUse: hai nhóm cấu trúc nhân quả khác nhau (động từ như lead to / result in và giới từ như because of)
write.modelAfterSubmit: Keeping a phone in the bedroom at night can harm a teenager's well-being, mainly because it often leads to poor sleep. When the phone is within reach, many young people check one more notification or watch one more short video, and an hour can pass without them noticing. This late-night screen time results in fewer hours of sleep, and the bright light may also make it harder to fall asleep. Because of this, they are likely to feel tired and irritable the next day, which can take a toll on their mood and concentration. For instance, my classmate Lan used to scroll until nearly midnight and often looked exhausted in class. However, the effect depends on how the phone is used, and setting a time to switch it off can make a real difference.
